scope: Four servings of egg-and-milk white sauce. 400g weighed whole milk, 30g butter, 30g wheat flour, 120g peeled fully hard-boiled eggs, 15g fresh dill, 3g salt, 0.3g white pepper with conservative omission bound. All edible components retained. Editorial calculated nutrition, not a lab measurement.
